ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the complex web of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent lawsuits and investigations.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could reveal a large-scale scheme, and I recommend using data analysis and public records to uncover the truth.
